The God King Problem

You can raise mountains. You cannot give a single order.

Shape the land and watch what your people make of it. Water makes fields rich, and winter judges everyone.

Drag the land with the hand, or use a tool · right- or middle-drag to turn · scroll or pinch to zoom

World seeds

Every world is made from its seed: the same seed makes the same land, the same nodes, the same first souls. Save one to start a new game on it (Set up › World), or give it to a friend.

This world:

The god's hands

Raise and Lower sculpt the land. Level flattens toward wherever you started the stroke: start on a meadow and drag through a ridge to cut a pass. Water fills the circle with water: drag it for a river, hold it for a lake. Fields near water grow rich. Forest plants trees (wood for homes and winter fires), and Clear takes them away.

Terrain also plants a Forest, Clears it, and sets down seams of Stone and Ore. Lightning strikes where you click: it splits trees, and it kills. The wind carries the weather across the land, clouds rain on what's under them, and storms throw their own lightning.

Grab lifts whoever or whatever's under your hand: a villager, a beast, one of the fresh dead, a boat or a ship (everyone aboard falls out). Let go while moving to throw them (gently, or not). Look never grabs. Pour drops a new soul from your hand, one at a time.

Powers past lightning: Sunburst burns whatever stands under a clear sky; Healing rain grows the crops and heals the hurt; Clear sky melts the clouds over a wide round for half a season; Deny death rings a place where nobody can die, and the fallen rise; a Storm hangs over the land raining lightning; a Tornado wanders with the wind taking up everything in its path; the Meteor breaks the ground. A town's priest prays for some of these himself.

Sound (top right) sets the sounds and the music; tap or click once to wake them.

Nobody takes orders. The village builds, farms and chops on its own. Hungry people leave, and frightened people run.

1–0, G, H tools · Esc put the tool down · [ ] brush size · F fertility · M sound off/on · Space pause · WASD move · Q/E turn · Alt-drag to tilt
